newsitem.title: FINLAND: M-SERLA PLANS TO BUY POLISH TISSUE MAKER.
newsitem.headline: M-SERLA PLANS TO BUY POLISH TISSUE MAKER.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group Metsa-Serla Oy said on Wednesday it had signed a letter of intent to buy a majority in Polish tissue maker Warszawskie Zaklady Papierniche S.A. for slightly under 50 million markka.
"The intention is to confirm the deal by the end of July," Metsa-Serla said in a statement.
The Polish company's annual production was 20,000 tonnes of tissue paper, or 20 percent of total output of tissue in Poland.
"Operations have been profitable in the last few years," Metsa-Serla said.
"Metsa-Serla's intention is to develop the mill's tissue paper operations and strengthen its market position," it said.

Metsa-Serla is the market leader in tissue paper in all Nordic countries. The tissue business group's annual net sales are about two billion markka, it said. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
